item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-09-13
item.description: "OSPP (Open-Source-Summer / 开源之夏, the Chinese government-backed Summer-of-Code-type program initiated by the Institute of Software of the Chinese Academy of Sciences) announces its 2026 Phase 2.0 redesign with five formal institutional-design changes — (1) the funding gate is now restricted to foundational-software and RISC-V ecosystem projects, (2) enterprises are opened as first-time participants alongside open-source communities (previously community-only), (3) a new Pioneer Mode (领航模式) inverts the problem-definition authority from organization to student under a committee-invitation gating mechanism, (4) all fixed deadlines are removed in favor of year-round rolling operation, and (5) the compensation-scale is priced at 3,500–5,000 yuan for the classic mode and 6,000–10,000 yuan for the Pioneer Mode across a 2–6 month development cycle; alongside the OSPP 2.0 anchor, this briefing documents for the first time a three-tier competition operationalization across three institutionally parallel organizer scales — the community-scale Hack-Astron × openKylin Skill Development Challenge (500 yuan, September 9 briefing, scoring open-source-contribution-norms alongside technical criteria), the enterprise-scale Alibaba Cloud Qwen3.8-27B Experience Contest (10,000 yuan cash prize pool, operating as a user-behavior-elicitation mechanism), and the municipal-government-scale Zhengzhou 2026 Agent Innovation Application Competition (Zhengzhou City Industry and Information Technology Bureau + Zhengdong New District, three tracks including a directed-specific track where enterprises pose problems and the competition judges on enterprise-accepted solutions, finals September 18–22); the two-axis-parallel-operationalization pattern — community-scale-and-government-scale operationalization (OSPP 2.0) plus competition-scale-and-organizer-scale operationalization (three-tier competition) — is a structurally new institutional-form object on the Chinese open-source talent-pipeline-and-technical-priority-agenda surface that prior cycles had not yet observed together."
